name: Agor
description: Runs multiplayer spatial boards where teams and coding agents share git branches, sessions, and dev environments, with scheduling and a built-in MCP server, for software teams.

skills.name: Boards and Zones
skills.description: Organizes branches and agent sessions on a live 2D canvas where dropping a branch into a zone fires a templated prompt.

skills.name: Session Trees
skills.description: Forks sessions to explore alternatives and spawns subsessions for focused subtasks, across interchangeable agent runtimes.

skills.name: Scheduler
skills.description: Triggers templated prompts on cron-style schedules for standups, audits, and teammate heartbeats.

skills.name: Agor MCP Server
skills.description: Lets agents introspect and drive sessions, branches, and boards through a built-in MCP server with scoped tokens.

skills.name: Message Gateway
skills.description: Lets people work with AI teammates from Slack and GitHub without opening the board.
